  (policy : DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D)
  (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D),
  Iff
    (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.PolicyFailure P A D) PUnit.{1})
      (@DefiKernel.Atomic.checkPolicy P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 policy boundaries left right)
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.PolicyFailure P A D) PUnit.{1} PUnit.unit.{1}))
    (And
      (@List.Nodup.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} D A)
        (@List.map.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Lane P A D) (Prod.{0, 0} D A)
          (fun lane =>
            @Prod.mk.{0, 0} D A (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Lane.domain P A D lane) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Lane.asset P A D lane))
          (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy.lanes P A D policy)))
      (And (@List.Nodup.{0} P (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy.participants P A D policy))
        (And
          (∀ (i : Nat),
            @LT.lt.{0} Nat instLTNat i (@List.length.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) left) →
              @Membership.mem.{0, 0} P (List.{0} P) (@List.instMembership.{0} P)
                (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy.participants P A D policy)
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.InvocationContext.principal P D
                  (@DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary.ctx P A D (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.left i))))
          (∀ (i : Nat),
            @LT.lt.{0} Nat instLTNat i (@List.length.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) right) →
              @Membership.mem.{0, 0} P (List.{0} P) (@List.instMembership.{0} P)
                (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy.participants P A D policy)
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.InvocationContext.principal P D
                  (@DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary.ctx P A D (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.right i)))))))

  (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) (m : DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine P A D)
  (schedule : DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule),
  ∃ preTokens suffix,
    And
      (@Eq.{1} DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule schedule
        (@HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule
          DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule
          (@instHAppendOfAppend.{0} DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule
            (@List.instAppend.{0} DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId))
          preTokens suffix))

          (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.speculative P A D
            (@DefiKernel.Atomic.continueRun P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries policy left
              right m schedule))
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.continueRun P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries left right
            (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.speculative P A D m) preTokens))
        (And

                right m schedule))

          (@Eq.{1} (Option.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.AbortReason P A D))
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.abort P A D
                (@DefiKernel.Atomic.continueRun P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries policy left
                  right m schedule))
              (@Option.none.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.AbortReason P A D)) →
            @Eq.{1} DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule suffix (@List.nil.{0} DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId))))

name: DefiKernel.Atomic.interleaving_advance_appended
statement:
∀ {P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} D]
  [inst_3 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} D] (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D)
  (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D) (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D)
  (m : DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine P A D) (branch : DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId)
  (inv : DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D),
  @Eq.{1} (Option.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.LocatedFailure P A D))
      (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.failure P A D (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.local P A D m branch))
      (@Option.none.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.LocatedFailure P A D)) →
    @Eq.{1} (Option.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D))
        (@GetElem?.getElem?.{0, 0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) Nat (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D)
          (fun as i => @LT.lt.{0} Nat instLTNat i (@List.length.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) as))
          (@List.instGetElem?NatLtLength.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D))
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.selectBranch P A D left right branch)
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.consumed P A D (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.local P A D m branch)))
        (@Option.some.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) inv) →
      @Eq.{1} (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D))
        (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.attempts P A D
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.advance P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries left right m
            branch))
        (@HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D))
          (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D))
          (@instHAppendOfAppend.{0} (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D))
            (@List.instAppend.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)))
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.attempts P A D m)
          (@List.cons.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)
            (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.mk P A D branch
              (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.nextIndex P A D
                (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.local P A D m branch))
              inv (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.world P A D m)
              (@DefiKernel.Composition.executeStep P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg
                (boundaries branch
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.nextIndex P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.local P A D m branch)))
                (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.nextIndex P A D
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.local P A D m branch))
                (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.outputs P A D
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.local P A D m branch))
                (@DefiKernel.Composition.Step.invoke P A D inv) (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.world P A D m)))
            (@List.nil.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D))))

          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.selectBranch P A D left right branch)
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.consumed P A D (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.local P A D m branch)))
        (@Option.some.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) inv) →
      @Eq.{1} (Option.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D))
        (@GetElem?.getElem?.{0, 0, 0} (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)) Nat
          (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)

        (@Option.some.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)

            (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.nextIndex P A D

              (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.outputs P A D

statement:
∀ {P A D : Type} (policy : DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy P A D) (owed : DefiKernel.Atomic.Outstanding P A D)
  (r : DefiKernel.Atomic.Residual P A D),
  Iff
    (@Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Residual P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Residual P A D))
      (@List.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Residual P A D)) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.residuals P A D policy owed) r)
    (And
      (@Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Lane P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Lane P A D))
        (@List.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Lane P A D)) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy.lanes P A D policy)
        (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Residual.lane P A D r))
      (And
        (@Membership.mem.{0, 0} P (List.{0} P) (@List.instMembership.{0} P)

        (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf rf)) →
    ∀ (n : Nat) (inv : DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D),
      @Eq.{1} (Option.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D))
          (@GetElem?.getElem?.{0, 0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) Nat (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D)
            (fun as i => @LT.lt.{0} Nat instLTNat i (@List.length.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) as))

              (∀ (c : DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D),
                @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                    (@List.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))

                  @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                    (@List.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))

                @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))

                  @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))

name: DefiKernel.Nary.joint_advanceMonitored
statement:
∀ {B P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq.{1} D] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_6 : Fintype.{0} D] {Q : Type}
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Nary.Boundaries B P A D)
  (branches : DefiKernel.Nary.Branches B P A D) (update : Q → DefiKernel.Nary.MonitorInput B P A D → Q)
  (K : DefiKernel.Nary.JointInvariant Q B P A D) (invariant : B → DefiKernel.Typed.State P A D → Prop)
  (guarantee rely : B → DefiKernel.Typed.State P A D → DefiKernel.Typed.State P A D → Prop)
  (assumption : DefiKernel.Nary.AssumptionFamily B Q P A D) (external : DefiKernel.Nary.ExternalFamily B Q P A D),
  @DefiKernel.Nary.InvariantDerivation B P A D Q K invariant →
    @DefiKernel.Nary.AssumptionDerivation B P A D Q K assumption external →
      @DefiKernel.Nary.PresentExternal B P A D Q K external →
        @DefiKernel.Nary.SelectedSuccessGuarantee B P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 Q cfg boundaries
            branches invariant guarantee assumption →
          @DefiKernel.Nary.GuaranteeInclusion B P A D guarantee rely →
            @DefiKernel.Nary.RelyStable B P A D invariant rely →
              @DefiKernel.Nary.SkipUpdateObligation B P A D inst Q cfg boundaries branches update K →
                @DefiKernel.Nary.RefusalUpdateObligation B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 Q cfg
                    boundaries branches update K →
                  @DefiKernel.Nary.SuccessUpdateObligation B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 Q cfg
                      boundaries branches update K invariant guarantee assumption →
                    ∀ (entry : Prod.{0, 0} Q (DefiKernel.Nary.Machine B P A D)),
                      K (@Prod.fst.{0, 0} Q (DefiKernel.Nary.Machine B P A D) entry)
                          (@Prod.snd.{0, 0} Q (DefiKernel.Nary.Machine B P A D) entry) →
                        ∀ (b : B),
                          And

  (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D) (policy : DefiKernel.Atomic.Policy P A D)
  (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) (m : DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine P A D)

  @Eq.{1} (DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine P A D)
    (@DefiKernel.Atomic.advance P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries policy left right m branch)
    (@DefiKernel.Atomic.advance.match_5.{1} P A D (fun x => DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine P A D)
      (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.abort P A D m) (fun val => m) fun _ =>
      have next :=
        @DefiKernel.Interleaving.advance P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries left right
          (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.speculative P A D m) branch;
      have running :=
        @DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.mk P A D (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.entryWorld P A D m) next
          (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.outstanding P A D m)
          (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.position P A D m)
            (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
          (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.abort P A D m);
      @DefiKernel.Atomic.advance.match_3.{1} P A D (fun x => DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine P A D)
        (@GetElem?.getElem?.{0, 0, 0} (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)) Nat
          (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)
          (fun as i => @LT.lt.{0} Nat instLTNat i (@List.length.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D) as))
          (@List.instGetElem?NatLtLength.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D))
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.attempts P A D next)
          (@List.length.{0} (DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt P A D)
            (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.attempts P A D (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.speculative P A D m))))
        (fun _ => running) fun attempt =>
        @DefiKernel.Atomic.observeAttempt.match_1.{1} P A D (fun x => DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine P A D)
          (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.outcome P A D attempt)
          (fun reason =>
            @DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.mk P A D (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.entryWorld P A D running)
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.speculative P A D running)
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.outstanding P A D running) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.position P A D running)
              (@Option.some.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.AbortReason P A D)
                (@DefiKernel.Atomic.AbortReason.kernel P A D (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.branch P A D attempt)
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.index P A D attempt) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.position P A D m)
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.invocation P A D attempt) reason)))
          fun result =>
          have owed :=
            @DefiKernel.Atomic.updateOutstanding P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 policy
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.outstanding P A D m)
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.InvocationContext.principal P D
                (@DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary.ctx P A D

                    (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.index P A D attempt))))
              (@DefiKernel.Composition.StepResult.receipt P A D result);
          have accepted :=
            @DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.mk P A D (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.entryWorld P A D running)
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.speculative P A D running) owed
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.position P A D running) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.abort P A D running);
          @DefiKernel.Atomic.advance.match_1.{1} P A D (fun x => DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine P A D)
            (@DefiKernel.Atomic.checkSupply P A D inst_1 inst_2 policy
              (@DefiKernel.Composition.StepResult.receipt P A D result))
            (fun _ => accepted) fun lane amount =>
            @DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.mk P A D (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.entryWorld P A D accepted)
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.speculative P A D accepted)
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.outstanding P A D accepted)
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.position P A D accepted)
              (@Option.some.{0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.AbortReason P A D)
                (@DefiKernel.Atomic.AbortReason.laneSupply P A D (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.branch P A D attempt)
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.index P A D attempt) (@DefiKernel.Atomic.Machine.position P A D m)
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Attempt.invocation P A D attempt) lane amount)))

statement:

  (pre : DefiKernel.Composition.World P A D) (boundary : DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary P A D)
  (request : DefiKernel.Typed.Request P A D) (e : DefiKernel.Typed.Evaluated P A D),
  @Eq.{1} Prop
    (@DefiKernel.Composition.ReceiptAuthorized P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 pre boundary
      (@DefiKernel.Composition.Receipt.invoked P A D request e))
    (And
      (@Eq.{1} Bool
        (@DefiKernel.Typed.hasAuthority P A D inst inst_1 inst_2
          (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.capabilities P A D pre)
          (@DefiKernel.Typed.Request.capabilityIds P A D request) (@DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary.ctx P A D boundary)
          (@DefiKernel.Typed.Request.operation P A D request) (@DefiKernel.Typed.Right.invoke P A D))
        Bool.true)
      (And
        (∀ (c : DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D),
          @LT.lt.{0} Rat Rat.instLT (@DefiKernel.Typed.Evaluated.effect P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 e c)
              (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Rat (nat_lit 0) (@Rat.instOfNat (nat_lit 0))) →
            @Eq.{1} Bool
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.hasAuthority P A D inst inst_1 inst_2
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.capabilities P A D pre)
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.Request.capabilityIds P A D request)
                (@DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary.ctx P A D boundary)
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.Request.operation P A D request) (@DefiKernel.Typed.Right.debit P A D c))
              Bool.true)
        (∀ (d : D) (a : A),
          @Ne.{1} Rat (@DefiKernel.Typed.Evaluated.supply P A D inst_1 inst_2 e d a)
              (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Rat (nat_lit 0) (@Rat.instOfNat (nat_lit 0))) →
            @Eq.{1} Bool
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.hasAuthority P A D inst inst_1 inst_2
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.capabilities P A D pre)
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.Request.capabilityIds P A D request)
                (@DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary.ctx P A D boundary)
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.Request.operation P A D request) (@DefiKernel.Typed.Right.changeSupply P A D d a))
              Bool.true)))

  (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D) (initial : DefiKernel.Composition.World P A D)
  (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) (lf rf : DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D)))
      (@DefiKernel.Parallel.admit P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg boundaries left right)
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
        (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf rf)) →
    ∀ (m : DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine P A D),
      @DefiKernel.Interleaving.Reachable P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries left right initial
          m →
        ∀ (b : DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId),
          ∀ c ∉ @DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.writes P A D (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Recovery.footprint P A D lf rf b),
            @Eq.{1} Rat
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.State.balance P A D
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D
                  (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Machine.world P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.advance P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg boundaries left
                      right m b)))
                c)

                  (@List.instGetElem?NatLtLength.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D)) (branches b)

            (executed :

  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Nary.Boundaries B P A D)
  (initial : DefiKernel.Composition.World P A D) (branches : DefiKernel.Nary.Branches B P A D)
  (roster : @DefiKernel.Nary.Roster B inst) (assoc : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))))
      (@DefiKernel.Nary.analyzeAll B P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 cfg boundaries branches
        (@DefiKernel.Nary.Roster.order B inst roster))
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))) assoc) →
    ∀ (m : DefiKernel.Nary.Machine B P A D),
      @DefiKernel.Nary.Reachable B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries branches initial
          m →
        ∀ (b : B),
          ∀ c ∉ @DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.writes P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.footprintOf B P A D inst assoc b),
            @Eq.{1} Rat
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.State.balance P A D
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D
                  (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.world B P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Nary.advance B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries
                      branches m b)))
                c)
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.State.balance P A D
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.world B P A D m)) c)

name: DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.advance_own_agrees
statement:
∀ {B P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq.{1} D] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_6 : Fintype.{0} D]
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Nary.Boundaries B P A D)
  (initial : DefiKernel.Composition.World P A D) (branches : DefiKernel.Nary.Branches B P A D)
  (roster : @DefiKernel.Nary.Roster B inst) (assoc : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))))
      (@DefiKernel.Nary.analyzeAll B P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 cfg boundaries branches
        (@DefiKernel.Nary.Roster.order B inst roster))
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))) assoc) →
    ∀ (m : DefiKernel.Nary.Machine B P A D),
      @DefiKernel.Nary.Reachable B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries branches initial
          m →
        ∀ (b : B),
          @DefiKernel.Parallel.CursorAgrees P A D
              (@Set.ofPred.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) fun c =>
                @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                  (@List.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                  (@DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.reads P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.isolatedFootprint B P A D inst assoc b))
                  c)
              (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.toCursor P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.locals B P A D m b)
                (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.world B P A D m))
              (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.isolated P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg (boundaries b) initial
                (branches b)
                (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.consumed P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.locals B P A D m b))) →
            have post :=
              @DefiKernel.Nary.advance B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries branches m
                b;
            @DefiKernel.Parallel.CursorAgrees P A D
              (@Set.ofPred.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) fun c =>
                @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                  (@List.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                  (@DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.reads P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.isolatedFootprint B P A D inst assoc b))
                  c)
              (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.toCursor P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.locals B P A D post b)
                (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.world B P A D post))
              (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.isolated P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg (boundaries b) initial
                (branches b)
                (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.LocalState.consumed P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.locals B P A D post b)))

name: DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.complete_local_observation
statement:
∀ {B P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq.{1} D] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_6 : Fintype.{0} D]
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Nary.Boundaries B P A D)
  (initial : DefiKernel.Composition.World P A D) (branches : DefiKernel.Nary.Branches B P A D)
  (roster : @DefiKernel.Nary.Roster B inst) (assoc : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))),
  @Eq.{1} Bool
      (@DefiKernel.Composition.validateCatalog P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3
        (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.registry P A D cfg) (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.catalog P A D cfg))
      Bool.true →
    @Eq.{1}
        (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
          (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))))
        (@DefiKernel.Nary.analyzeAll B P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 cfg boundaries branches
          (@DefiKernel.Nary.Roster.order B inst roster))
        (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
          (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))) assoc) →
      @DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.PairwiseCompatible B P A D assoc →
        ∀ (schedule : DefiKernel.Nary.Schedule B),
          @DefiKernel.Nary.Complete B P A D inst branches schedule →
            ∀ (b : B),
              @Eq.{1} (DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.CanonicalLocal P A D)
                (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.toCanonicalLocal P A D
                  (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.locals B P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Nary.runPrefix B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries
                      initial branches schedule)
                    b)
                  (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.world B P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Nary.runPrefix B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries
                      initial branches schedule)))
                (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.isolatedCanonicalLocal P A D
                  (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.IsolatedRef.cursor P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.runIsolatedLeaf P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg
                      (boundaries b) initial (branches b)))
                  (branches b))

          (@DefiKernel.Nary.analyzeAll B P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 cfg boundaries branches
            (@DefiKernel.Nary.Roster.order B inst roster))

                    boundaries initial tree branches schedule))

name: DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.complete_schedule_canonicalEq_of_admitIsolated

  [inst_3 : DecidableEq.{1} D] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_6 : Fintype.{0} D]

  (tree : DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.Tree B) (schedule : DefiKernel.Nary.Schedule B),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0}
        (Sum.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.TreeAdmissionFailure B P A D) (DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.PairConflict B P A D))
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))))
      (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.admitIsolated B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 cfg roster boundaries branches schedule
        tree)
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0}
        (Sum.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.TreeAdmissionFailure B P A D) (DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.PairConflict B P A D))
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))) assoc) →
    @Eq.{1} Bool
      (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.canonicalEq B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6
        (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.canonicalOf B P A D inst roster
          (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.runTreePrefix B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries
            initial tree branches schedule))
        (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.isolatedCanonical B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 roster cfg
          boundaries initial branches assoc tree))

  [inst_3 : DecidableEq.{1} D] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_6 : Fintype.{0} D]

  (tree : DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.Tree B) (s1 s2 : DefiKernel.Nary.Schedule B),
  @DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.WellFormed B inst roster tree →
    @Eq.{1} Bool
        (@DefiKernel.Composition.validateCatalog P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3
          (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.registry P A D cfg) (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.catalog P A D cfg))
        Bool.true →
      @Eq.{1}
          (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
            (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))))
          (@DefiKernel.Nary.analyzeAll B P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 cfg boundaries branches
            (@DefiKernel.Nary.Roster.order B inst roster))
          (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
            (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))) assoc) →
        @DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.PairwiseCompatible B P A D assoc →
          @DefiKernel.Nary.Complete B P A D inst branches s1 →
            @DefiKernel.Nary.Complete B P A D inst branches s2 →
              @Eq.{1} Bool
                (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.canonicalEq B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6
                  (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.canonicalOf B P A D inst roster

            (@DefiKernel.Nary.Roster.order B inst roster))

name: DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.continue_outside
statement:
∀ {B P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq.{1} D] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_6 : Fintype.{0} D]
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Nary.Boundaries B P A D)
  (initial : DefiKernel.Composition.World P A D) (branches : DefiKernel.Nary.Branches B P A D)
  (roster : @DefiKernel.Nary.Roster B inst) (assoc : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))))
      (@DefiKernel.Nary.analyzeAll B P A D inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 cfg boundaries branches
        (@DefiKernel.Nary.Roster.order B inst roster))
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Nary.AdmissionFailure B P A D)
        (List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} B (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))) assoc) →
    ∀ (m : DefiKernel.Nary.Machine B P A D),
      @DefiKernel.Nary.Reachable B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries branches initial
          m →
        ∀ (schedule : DefiKernel.Nary.Schedule B) (c : DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D),
          (∀ (b : B),
              c ∉
                @DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.writes P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.footprintOf B P A D inst assoc b)) →
            @Eq.{1} Rat
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.State.balance P A D
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D
                  (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.world B P A D
                    (@DefiKernel.Nary.continueRun B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries
                      branches m schedule)))
                c)
              (@DefiKernel.Typed.State.balance P A D
                (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D (@DefiKernel.Nary.Machine.world B P A D m)) c)

        @DefiKernel.Nary.Reachable B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries branches
            initial m →
          @DefiKernel.Nary.Tree.Simulates B P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 cfg boundaries initial

          (@GetElem?.getElem?.{0, 0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) Nat (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D)

                @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))

                @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (List.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                    (@List.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                    (@DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.writes P A D part) c →
